inj.note: Al-Shaair battled a knee injury during Week 7 prep but seemed to be fine Sunday, as he played every one of Houston's defensive snaps. The veteran linebacker has been a consistent producer this season, logging at least seven stops in each of the six contests in which he's played. Al-Shaair posted 103 tackles over 16 regular-season games last year, and he's on pace to easily surpass that mark with 58 stops through six contests this season.

news.h: Kyrie Irving explains offer to pay Al-Shaair's eye black fine
news.d: Azeez Al-Shaair was fined after he wore the name Hind Rajab on his eye black during the Texans' season opener.
